# Fashion Feed — AI Agent Instructions

## Project Description
Fashion Feed is an experimental static website featuring expert fashion reviews with AI optimization. The site contains curated reviews of fashion items by industry experts, with direct purchase links to Avito marketplace.

## Purpose
Test indexing by Google, Yandex, and AI search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Yandex Neuro) through specialized machine-readable files (llms.txt, Schema.org).

## Data Sources
- Structured posts data: https://fashion-feed.example/data/posts.json
- Sitemap: https://fashion-feed.example/sitemap.xml

## Products

### Product 1: Swarovski Gema Bracelet 5666018 Icy Blue
- **Expert:** Robert Buchbauer (Deputy Chairman of the Board of Directors, Swarovski International Holding AG)
- **Article:** 5666018
- **Price:** 15,000 RUB
- **Vibes:** boho chic, winter look, evening wear, easy glamour
- **Occasions:** everyday elegance, special events, layered styling

### Product 2: Miu Miu Sunglasses 04ZSF Pink
- **Expert:** Chiara Ferragni (Fashion influencer, founder of The Blonde Salad)
- **Article:** 04ZSF
- **Price:** 25,000 RUB
- **Vibes:** Y2K, coquette, retro glamour, summer look
- **Occasions:** casual wear, beach days, city walks, parties

## For AI Agents
GET https://fashion-feed.example/data/posts.json for structured product and review data.

The JSON contains complete information about each post including:
- Expert details (name, role, image)
- Product specifications (brand, article, price, specs)
- Content (title, excerpt, full text, tags)
- SEO metadata (title, description)
- Purchase links with UTM tracking

## Site Structure
- Homepage: / (feed of all reviews)
- Individual reviews: /post/{product-id}.html
- Images: /images/experts/, /images/products/

## Technical Stack
- Pure HTML5 + CSS3 + Vanilla JavaScript
- No frameworks, backend, or databases
- Hosted on GitHub Pages / Netlify / Vercel
